g.text: Palace: The 100 µm fillet on 'pin' (fillet(side|top)) puts elements of about 52.36 µm
on it — a quarter of the smallest elsewhere — and will dominate the mesh.
Disabling it (its Enabled box) shows whether it matters.
openEMS: openEMS staircases the curved faces of 'housing' at ≥ 4 cells across
their smallest radius (670 µm); refining the grid converges them.
openEMS: openEMS will not represent the 100 µm fillet on 'pin' (fillet(side|top)):
